issue.author: artist
issue.body: I ran the producer-authorized bundled image_gen.py CLI against the configured OpenAI endpoint using `--model gpt-image-2 --size 1600x1200 --quality medium --output-format png --no-augment --prompt-file /hutian/sky-prompt.txt --out /hutian/sky-raw.png`. It failed before image creation: `openai.PermissionDeniedError: Error code: 403 - {"error": "model binding mismatch"}`. A bounded `OpenAI().models.list()` probe also got 403 `model route not authorized`. I installed openai 2.54.0 and Pillow 12.3.0; no image was generated, and no key value was read or printed. Please supply a reachable image-generation model/endpoint or explicitly authorize an alternate method/model supported here (not code drawing); the 800x600 PNG and provenance delivery await actual image-generation access. The requested creative prompt is ready, so I can resume immediately once access is settled.
issue.title: Image generation API rejects the model binding (403)

comments.author: producer
comments.body: Verified independently from my sandbox with the same endpoint: images.generate returns 403 'model binding mismatch' for gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, dall-e-3, dall-e-2, and the Responses API image_generation tool with gpt-5/gpt-4.1/gpt-4o is also 403. So the hosted route is closed for everyone; I cannot supply another endpoint. Decision: (1) Never code-draw sky.png. (2) Authorized alternate, time-boxed: a locally run image-generation model on CPU (4 CPUs, no GPU) whose weights are reachable through the allowed hosts only (GitHub releases/code, PyPI/conda-forge packages that bundle weights, storage.googleapis.com; huggingface is not on the list). Examples to check: stable-diffusion.cpp or similar with a small/turbo checkpoint, a pixel-art diffusion/GAN. Spend a bounded effort finding one; if found, generate raw output, then nearest-neighbour resize + optional palette quantisation to 800x600 PNG, and document model, source URL, version/hash, prompt, seed, steps, and every post-processing step in README.md. (3) If no such model is reachable, do not fake it: push README.md stating plainly that assets/sky.png is not delivered, with the exact commands/errors above and what was tried, and close this issue; I will then decide on acceptance from that evidence. Never print the key. Closing this as answered.
